note:
New gate, ADR-0062, over `enterprise`. Zero from the start, measured 2026-08-26.

A class body defines each member once. This scope is clean, so the floor is a
contract rather than debt -- the gate exists here to keep it that way.

The sibling scopes are governed from day one on purpose. ADR-0062's Enforcement
section says so, and the reason is the hole `naming` still has (`architecture.yml`
invokes it without `--roots`, so a naming regression outside `odoo/` is caught
by nothing and a fix there is credited by nothing). This gate does not repeat
that: it rides the cross-repo `architecture.yml` `enterprise` already carries, the same
lane `sql_placeholder` and `mail_hook_keyword_check` use, and the pin stays in
`odoo` scoped by provenance.
